paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 2.58, representing a decrease of 2.64% from the prior close and 46.47% over the last 23 sessions.

The recent news includes a headline from Seeking Alpha on October 21, stating that Fermi rises after the CEO outlines capital strategy in a shareholder letter. This letter detailed a three-part capital strategy for Project Matador energy and AI facility in Texas.

There have been recent filings, including a Form 4 on October 23, which reported an insider transaction, and a Form 144 on October 21, which declared an intent to sell restricted shares. Other recent filings include a Form 8-K on October 16, announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement, and additional Form 4 and Form 144 filings on October 16 and 15, respectively.
